pois.name: Telluride Gondola – Telluride Station
pois.blurb: Telluride Ski Resort is a ski resort located in Mountain Village, southwest Colorado, United States.

themeConnection.text: Operating free public gondola with a named terminal in the incorporated town of Telluride; it serves town access as well as recreation.

pois.name: Santo Domingo Teleférico – Gualey Station
pois.blurb: The Santo Domingo cable car is an aerial public-transit line serving neighborhoods of Santo Domingo, with passenger gondolas and several named stations.

themeConnection.text: Operating urban gondola transit system with a named terminal in Santo Domingo.

pois.name: Quito Teleférico – Plaza de los Cebollas
pois.blurb: The TelefériQo is a gondola lift in Quito ascending from the city toward Pichincha volcano, operating as a public visitor attraction with passenger cabins.

themeConnection.text: Regularly open visitor gondola attraction with its lower terminal inside Quito.

pois.name: Mérida Cable Car – Barinitas Station
pois.blurb: The Mérida cable car in Venezuela is a passenger aerial tramway beginning at Barinitas in the city and ascending toward Pico Espejo.

themeConnection.text: Operating long-span passenger cableway with its urban lower terminal in Mérida.

pois.name: Yeosu Maritime Cable Car – Dolsan Park Station
pois.blurb: The Yeosu Maritime Cable Car (Korean: 여수 해상케이블카) is an gondola lift in Yeosu, South Jeolla Province, South Korea. The lift connects the Dolsan Park on the island Dolsando to Jasan Park on the mainland.

themeConnection.text: Operating passenger cableway over Yeosu harbor with a named terminal inside Yeosu.

pois.name: Singapore Cable Car – Mount Faber Station
pois.blurb: The Singapore Cable Car is a gondola lift in Singapore, providing an aerial link from Mount Faber (Faber Peak Singapore) on Singapore Island to the resort island of Sentosa across the Keppel Harbour.

themeConnection.text: Operating visitor and public passenger gondola service from a named station in Singapore.

pois.name: Teleférico Warairarepano – Maripérez Station
pois.blurb: The Caracas cable car, now known as Teleférico Warairarepano, carries passengers from the city into El Ávila National Park as a visitor service.

themeConnection.text: Named lower station of an operating passenger cableway connecting Caracas with El Ávila visitor areas.

pois.name: Busan Air Cruise – Songdo Bay Station
pois.blurb: Busan Air Cruise, formerly Songdo Cable Car, is an aerial gondola attraction crossing Songdo Bay and carrying regular passenger traffic in Busan.

themeConnection.text: Regularly operating public visitor gondola crossing with a named station in Busan.

pois.name: Manizales Cable Aéreo – Fundadores Station
pois.blurb: The Manizales Gondola Lift, known in Spanish as Cable Aéreo Manizales, is a gondola lift system implemented in the cities of Manizales and Villamaría, Colombia for urban public transport.

themeConnection.text: Operating urban aerial cableway linking a named terminal in central Manizales with Villamaría.

pois.name: Aerovía Guayaquil – Julián Coronel Station
pois.blurb: Aerovía is an aerial cable-car public transport system in Guayaquil, Ecuador, carrying passengers between Guayaquil and Durán on scheduled service.

themeConnection.text: Operating urban aerial gondola system with a named passenger station in Guayaquil.

pois.name: Namsan Cable Car – Hoehyeon Station
pois.blurb: The Namsan Cable Car is an aerial cable car in Seoul carrying visitors between the Hoehyeon-area lower station and Namsan Mountain.

themeConnection.text: Operating visitor aerial cable car with a named lower station in Seoul.

pois.name: Bondinho do Pão de Açúcar – Praia Vermelha Station
pois.blurb: The Sugarloaf Mountain Cable Car, also called Bondinho, is an aerial tramway carrying visitors between stations in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

themeConnection.text: Operating public aerial tramway visitor service from a named station in Rio de Janeiro.

pois.name: Mi Teleférico – Línea Roja, Estación Central
pois.blurb: Mi Teleférico is an urban transit gondola-lift system serving La Paz and El Alto, Bolivia, with multiple lines and stations used for regular public transportation.

themeConnection.text: Operating urban gondola line with scheduled public passenger service from a named station in central La Paz.

pois.name: Hakodate Ropeway – Sanroku Station
pois.blurb: The Mt. Hakodate Ropeway (函館山ロープウェイ, Hakodateyama Rōpuwei) is the name of an aerial lift, as well as its operator. The line climbs Mount Hakodate in Hakodate, Japan.

themeConnection.text: Operating visitor aerial ropeway with a named lower station in Hakodate.

pois.name: Palm Springs Aerial Tramway – Valley Station
pois.blurb: The Palm Springs Aerial Tramway carries visitors in rotating aerial tramcars from the Valley Station in Palm Springs up Mount San Jacinto.

themeConnection.text: Regularly open visitor aerial tramway with its lower station in Palm Springs.

pois.name: IFS Cloud Cable Car – Royal Docks Station
pois.blurb: The London Cable Car is a gondola lift across the River Thames, operating between Greenwich Peninsula and the Royal Docks as a public passenger service.

themeConnection.text: Operating urban cable car with a named station inside London and regular passenger service.

pois.name: Maokong Gondola – Taipei Zoo Station
pois.blurb: The Maokong Gondola is a passenger gondola lift in Taipei, Taiwan, connecting Taipei Zoo with Maokong through several named stations.

themeConnection.text: Operating urban gondola visitor and transit service with a named terminal in Taipei.

pois.name: Ngong Ping 360 – Tung Chung Station
pois.blurb: Ngong Ping 360 is a gondola lift on Lantau Island, Hong Kong, carrying visitors between Tung Chung and Ngong Ping on scheduled service.

themeConnection.text: Operating visitor gondola service with a named terminal in the urban municipality of Hong Kong.

pois.name: Medellín Metrocable Line K – Acevedo Station
pois.blurb: The Medellín Metro system includes Metrocable aerial gondola lines that provide regular public transportation between metro stations and hillside neighborhoods.

themeConnection.text: Operating urban passenger gondola line integrated with Medellín Metro at the named Acevedo station.

pois.name: Roosevelt Island Tramway – Manhattan Station
pois.blurb: The Roosevelt Island Tramway is an aerial tramway in New York City carrying passengers between Manhattan and Roosevelt Island as public transportation.

themeConnection.text: Operating scheduled public aerial tramway linking Manhattan and Roosevelt Island.

clue.text: This operating urban gondola network provides scheduled public transport between a central terminal and another municipality, with three lines including a 2 km original route and a 705 m extension.

theme.title: Operating Aerial Passenger Cableways in Cities
theme.introduction: Above busy streets, cable cars trace unlikely paths through the sky. These urban aerial routes still carry passengers today.
theme.inclusionCriteria: Include a location only when every condition is met: (1) it is an individually named aerial passenger cableway, gondola lift, aerial tramway, cable car, teleférico, téléphérique, telecabine, or equivalent service; (2) passenger cabins, cars, or gondolas travel suspended above the ground on an overhead cable system rather than on rails; (3) it provides regularly scheduled public passenger service on the date of play, whether ordinary urban transit or a regularly open visitor attraction; (4) at least one named terminal or station lies within the current administrative boundary of a present-day city or incorporated urban municipality; and (5) the cableway, line, or a specific station can be pinned as one exact, visitable map location.
